title: You Just Needed To Be Met

scenes.narration: You spend years believing you are too difficult to hold.
scenes.image_query: You spend years believing you are too difficult to hold.

scenes.narration: You learn to carry your storms alone.
scenes.image_query: You learn to carry your storms alone.

scenes.narration: Until the day a gentle soul sees the parts of you, you were afraid would make them leave.
scenes.image_query: Until the day a gentle soul sees the parts of you, you were afraid would make them leave.

scenes.narration: And instead of stepping back, they move closer.
scenes.image_query: And instead of stepping back, they move closer.

scenes.narration: And suddenly you realize you never needed to be fixed.
scenes.image_query: And suddenly you realize you never needed to be fixed.

scenes.narration: You just needed to be met.
scenes.image_query: You just needed to be met.
